articleTitle: Design of a Digital Rf Beacon To Rescue The Soldiers Trapped In Ice Glaciers
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In demanding circumstances, army personnel face the challenging task of safeguarding our nation's borders. In India, the northern and northwestern borders are characterized by heavy snowfall. These locations pose significant challenges to soldiers who must endure extremely low temperatures while on duty. One common danger they encounter is the risk of being buried under snow glaciers that collapse and accumulate on them. Recently, a newspaper reported a remarkable incident in the Himalayan region where an Indian soldier, trapped under an avalanche for six days, was miraculously found alive and rescued from a depth of at least 7 meters (25 feet) beneath the snow. Tragically, nine others lost their lives in the same incident. The treacherous conditions at the 5,800-meterhigh glacier make military patrols there highly perilous. Therefore, any technology or system capable of saving even one soldier would provide immense support to their families, benefit the country, and enhance the morale and confidence of the military personnel. To address this issue, a proposed solution is the implementation of a Digital RF Beacon. This system aims to assist soldiers working in harsh environments, specifically identifying them when they become trapped in ice glaciers due to avalanches. Not only would this device be valuable for soldiers, but it could also aid civilians and mountain skiers who are at risk of being buried under ice glaciers during snow avalanches. Equipped with a transceiver and necessary sensors, this beacon would enable timely rescue operations by locating individuals in need. Additionally, it could serve as a safety device for enhanced protection.

articleTitle: Developing a New Inspection Plan for Shrimp Export Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Seafood export sector is a booming business worldwide. Shrimp remains a major export earner in Indian seafood industry. India stands fifth in shrimp production in the world. Each seafood processed consignments exported undergoes inspection relating to its quality parameters based on a sampling plan. This paper investigates the application of modified double sampling plan with least acceptance numbers, designated as MDSP (0, 1), for ensuring the quality of exported seafood. The optimal plan parameters of the MDSP (0,1) involving a minimum of the average sample number are determined based on two-points on the operating characteristic approach by formulating a nonlinear optimization problem. It is also shown that the proposed sampling plan outperforms the existing sampling procedures followed in the food industries.

articleTitle: Optimized ANN-based MPPT for Solar Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Photovoltaic systems are growing in popularity to generate clean electrical energy. Nevertheless, because of minimal efficiency, researchers have sought methods for enhancing its productivity. Maximum Power Point Trackers (MPPT) allow us to extract the most energy from PV panels that can be produced. It involves an algorithm to calculate the Maximum Power Point (MPP). The most commonly used MPPT methodologies, Incremental Conductance (I-C) and Perturb and Observe (P-O) provide long-term reliability for consistent environmental conditions, although tracking becomes complicated for varying environmental patterns. It was proved that ANN (Artificial Neural network) can track MPP with a small transient time and less ripple. Subsequently, to achieve the ideal MPP, the ANN method must be extensively adjusted. For desired performance, the number of hidden layers and neurons in every hidden layer must be properly chosen. Thus, the Seagull Optimisation (SO) algorithm is employed to optimise ANN in this work. Its capacity to perform is compared with that of P-O, ANN, and PSO. (Particle Swarm Optimization) for constant and varying climatic conditions.

articleTitle: Generalized Pythagorean Fuzzy Soft Expert Set (GPFSES) and its Applications in MCDM
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In this paper, we commence by presenting a novel notion termed Generalized Pythagorean Fuzzy Soft Expert Set(GPFSES). This innovative concept integrates pythagorean fuzzy sets with soft expert sets. Additionally, we establish operations, including complement, union and intersection on GPFSES, and scrutinize their inherent properties. Logical operations, such as AND and OR, are also outlined for GPFSES. We introduce an algorithm, known as MK-GPFSES, tailored for addressing multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) problems. Furthermore, we illustrate the application of this algorithm through a practical scenario.

Author Keywords: generalized Pythagorean fuzzy soft expert set

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Benefits of Grid-Connected Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Energy resources that offer substantial environmental benefits while also producing minimal economic impact are highly valued. Photovoltaic (PV) energy is an infinite, non-polluting energy resource that can be economically utilized to meet energy requirements. The study examines the technical and economic viability of a grid-connected PV system. To explore the influence of photovoltaic benefits on grid voltage support, a seven-bus power system model is created and analyzed using simulation software. Furthermore, the benefits of grid-connected solar PV systems in transmission and distribution, as well as line extension in rural areas of developing countries and consumers, are highlighted using literature reviews. The study concludes with an assessment of the technical and economic feasibility of the examined PV system profitability depending on the system site location, household load size, consumer energy cost, and existing PV subsidies.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Bruises in Fruit Thermograms During Post Harvest Stage Using K-Means Clustering Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Thermography is a beneficial technique for evaluating fruit quality non-destructively in the food processing industry. It allows for the identification of internal flaws like bruising. In this paper, the K-means clustering technique is applied to three different fruit types: guava, pomegranate, and apple, with the goal of segmenting bruises in fruit thermograms. The main goal is to improve automation in the sectors by quickly assessing quality in post-harvest procedures by easily identifying bruises. Preprocessing the fruit thermograms by scaling and conversion into appropriate colour space is part of the methodology. Because this study only includes three sample fruits, the bruised areas are identified using the simple K means clustering method to determine the nature of the fruit. The study identifies higher similarity regions for guava fruit and demonstrates the potential of K-means clustering as a dependable and adaptable tool for accurate bruise segmentation in guava fruits. In the future, this technique could be used to improve non-destructive inspection techniques in the agricultural sector.

articleTitle: Optimal Placement of PMU with Complete Observability using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Phasor Measurement Units(PMUs), play a pivotal role in controlling, monitoring, and protection of electrical networks. Achieving complete observability while minimizing the number of PMUs installed is a key consideration during PMU placement. This paper focus on Genetic Algorithm-based approaches for optimizing PMU placement to ensure full observability. The proposed technique is simulated using MATLAB on IEEE-57 bus systems. In addition, the obtained result is compared with the results of traditional methods.

articleTitle: Vision based Estimation of Runway relative Aircraft Position and Orientation
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Satellite based Navigation systems and Inertial Navigation systems (INS) are conventionally used for Aircraft Navigation. Instrumentation landing systems (ILS) needs equipment on runway as well as on the aircraft. When ILS or alternate navigation systems are not available, Vision based system can be used as an alternative to update INS. An algorithm is developed to estimate the Runway Relative Aircraft Position and Orientation during the final phase of landing when runway or pre-stored features/regions are visible. An algorithm is developed to identify three edges on the runway (Two along longitudinal left and right boundaries and the third one horizontal to the landing stripes) and to subsequently estimate the runway relative Position and Orientation using the complete camera perspective projection model. The test results suggest that Position estimates exhibit good accuracy.

articleTitle: Visualization of Real Time Forest Fire Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Forest fires are a serious hazard to both the environment and human life. For an effective and timely response, early detection of these fires is essential. This study offers a reliable method for detecting forest fires utilizing the cutting-edge real-time object identification technique known as the YOLO (You Only Look Once) algorithm method. The process entails gathering a varied dataset of photos that include both fire and non-fire scenarios, labeling the photos with bounding boxes, and using this dataset to refine a YOLO model that has already been trained. Subsequently, the YOLO model is applied to real-time fire detection in photos or live video streams sourced from forested regions. Traditional fire detection techniques have been employed, but deep learning-based techniques have drawn a lot of attention because of their high accuracy and capacity to understand intricate patterns. The current research problem of keeping computing costs low while attaining high accuracy rates with deep learning-based fire detection techniques is addressed in this study. In order to properly address this difficulty, this study provides a method based on the YOLOv8 algorithm that involves the training, validation, and testing of the model as well as its development using a bespoke dataset. The precision, recall, and F1-curve metrics provide a concise evaluation of the model's effectiveness. Notably, the model is highly proficient in fire detection, which is critical for early alerts and prevention. Our proposed method works better than existing state-of-the-art methods, according to experimental data and performance evaluations. This makes this method quite promising for fire detection.

articleTitle: Impact of Leadership Teamwork and Organizational Policies Towards Employee Engagement
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In today's rapidly evolving workplace landscape, employee engagement stands as a critical determinant of organizational success, shaped by the intricate interplay of leadership effectiveness, teamwork dynamics, and organizational policies. This study explores the impact of visionary leadership, emotionally intelligent leadership, and authentic leadership on employee engagement, along with the pivotal role of teamwork and the influence of well-crafted organizational policies. A survey-based research methodology involving a diverse demographic sample was employed, and the data were analyzed using SPSS. While chi-square tests revealed no significant individual associations, the comprehensive regression analysis demonstrated that leadership, teamwork, and organizational policies collectively explained 36.1% of the variance in employee engagement. The study emphasizes the need for organizations to invest in leadership development, foster effective teamwork, and continually refine policies to create a positive workplace culture. The findings underscore the dynamic nature of employee engagement, necessitating ongoing monitoring and tailored interventions to meet the evolving needs of a diverse workforce.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning Cloud Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The scalability and flexibility that cloud computing provides, organisations can readily adapt their resources to meet demand without having to make significant upfront expenditures in hardware infrastructure. Three main types of computing services are provided to people worldwide via the Internet. Increased performance and resource access are two benefits that come with using cloud computing, but there is also an increased chance of attack. As a result of this research, intrusion detection systems that can process massive amounts of data packets, analyse them, and produce reports using knowledge and behaviour analysis were created. Convolution Neural Network Algorithm encrypts data as it's being transmitted end-to-end and is stored in the cloud, providing an extra degree of security. Data protection in the cloud is improved by intrusion detection. This study uses a model to show how data is encrypted and decrypted, of an algorithm and describes the defences against attacks. When assessing the performance of the suggested system, it's critical to consider the time and memory needed to encrypt and decrypt big text files. Additionally, the security of the cloud has been investigated and contrasted with various encoding techniques now in use.

articleTitle: Robotic Endoscopic for Smart Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Developing healthcare systems for disease diagnosis and treatment require medical image segmentation as a vital prerequisite. U-Net, which is a U-shaped architecture, has become the standard in the segmentation of intestine images and has achieved remarkable success. The proposed approach is a novel medical image segmentation method that uses the TransUNet architecture, which combines both Transformers and U-Net, as an effective alternative. The system presents a review of the latest developments in robotic endoscopic systems, including their design, control algorithms, and clinical applications. The Transformer encodes tokenized image patches from a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) feature map to extract global contexts, while the decoder up samples the encoded features and combines them with high-resolution CNN feature maps to allow precise localization. The Transformers serve as robust encoders for medical image segmentation tasks, while the combination with U-Net improves the recovery of localized spatial information and enhances finer details

articleTitle: Diverse Image Processing Techniques for Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Machine learning is a trending topic in the area of computer vision, which makes the machine able to learn about it without being expressly programmed using various algorithms. When a model is designed to predict future-based on historical data using machine learning algorithms, data is vital because high quality data is needed to run the model efficiently and to predict highly accurate results. Machine learning algorithms receive data in many forms, like audio (speech recognition), images (feature recognition), numeric data (like height and weight) etc. When it comes to computer vision, the machine learning algorithms must be able to understand the image data, and before the images are processed to the algorithms it should be pre-processed (cleaned and set to the desired format) using various image pre-processing techniques. This research paper presents various image processing techniques, literature reviews on various image processing techniques and image PSNR value after applying median filter, grayscale filter and box filters.

articleTitle: Emotional Harmony through Deep Learning: A Facial Expression-Based Music Therapy
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This research paper focuses on creating an advanced Music Recommendation System through a five-phase approach. Beginning with Data Collection and Extraction, the project utilizes the FER dataset for face images and the Spotify Web API to gather a diverse collection of musical tracks. Subsequent Data Cleaning and Preprocessing procedures refine the datasets, including streamlining the FER dataset for essential emotions and organizing music data in a database for accessibility. The research's core lies in Model Building, employing a custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model named FERNET for precise emotion classification. Rigorous Model Optimization ensures an impressive 96% accuracy rate in emotion classification. The project concludes with the development of the Mood-Music App, a user-friendly application integrating the FER module, Emotion Recognition module, and Songs Recommendation module. This app utilizes real-time emotion analysis to provide a personalized and immersive music discovery experience, revolutionizing user engagement with music. The research showcases a comprehensive methodology, from data collection to the deployment of a sophisticated app, contributing significantly to the field of Music Recommendation Systems.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Multifunction Robotic Arm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The study discusses the design and implementation of a 6-Degree of Freedom (DOF) robotic arm designed for multipurpose use, particularly for the elderly or those with special needs. The arm's unique feature is its precise control over its joints, controlled using robotic kinematics concepts and MATLAB processing capabilities. The proposed algorithms are verified through stick diagram verification. A Graphical User Interface (GUI) is designed for user-friendly control, and the Arduino MEGA2560 I/O board serves as the primary hub. A MATLAB simulation is created to ensure the algorithm's accuracy and usefulness, and the simulated arm is tested for accuracy and functionality using forward and inverse transformations. The aim is to empower individuals to work freely and perform activities that would otherwise be impossible.

articleTitle: Paralysis and Stroke Prediction System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Paralysis and stroke are debilitating medical conditions that can have life-altering consequences if not detected and treated early. Predictive models should be developed for early prediction of these conditions so that patients could take preventative measures. In this study, we propose a Paralysis and Stroke Prediction System (PSPS) which uses the Random Forest algorithm, which is one of the powerful machine learning techniques which is known to be the most accurate and versatile algorithm. The PSPS leverages a diverse set of patient's information, including demographic data like age, gender, medical chronicle, habits and practices, and medical examinations to create a robust prediction model. As said earlier, the Random Forest algorithm, which is one of the most versatile algorithms known to handle complex and large datasets, is employed to build an ensemble of decision trees that collectively provide accurate predictions. Ultimately, the PSPS has the potential to significantly improve patient care and reduce the burden of paralysis and stroke on healthcare systems.

articleTitle: AI Enhanced Phishing Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: It attempts to create a sophisticated system that uses artificial intelligence (AI) methods to prevent and detect phishing assaults in advance. Cybersecurity is seriously threatened by phishing attempts, which take advantage of human weakness to trick people into disclosing private information. In order to precisely identify and categorize any phishing attempts, the suggested method makes use of machine learning algorithms and natural language processing (NLP) to examine a variety of characteristics of emails, websites, and digital interactions.This project uses AI-driven methods to improve cybersecurity defenses already in place by offering a more reliable and effective way to detect and stop phishing assaults, protecting people and businesses from the negative effects of cyberattacks.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Resume Based QA Tailoring for Success in Interviews
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In today's competitive job market, individuals encounter the challenge of aligning their skills with suitable job opportunities that match their interests. To tackle this, the system utilizes Natural Language Processing (NLP), leveraging Large Language Models (LLM) such as BERT, T5, ROBERTA, and XLNET. Through the analysis of resumes and job descriptions, it extracts keywords and generates Q&A, significantly increasing the likelihood of finding a role that aligns with their skills and aspirations. Achieving semantic accuracy, it delivers meaningful question and answer generation with an impressive 97% accuracy compared to previous works. This support empowers students and job seekers to confidently showcase their strengths, facilitating a more impactful journey towards securing meaningful employment. Additionally, the system provides a comprehensive analysis of the performance of each model.

articleTitle: Sign Language Translation Using Image Processing to Audio Conversion
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Sign language has long been a fundamental mode of communication for deaf and mute individuals, serving as a crucial tool for inclusivity and interaction. Nonetheless, communication barriers persist as many individuals outside of these communities struggle to comprehend and utilize sign language effectively. A ground-breaking system known as hand gesture recognition using image processing to audio conversion has emerged to address this issue. This innovative system aims to develop an application capable of translating sign language and hand gestures into text and audio, thereby facilitating communication between deaf and mute individuals and the wider society. This system enables the detection and classification of hand gestures by employing computer vision techniques, such as CNN algorithms for image processing and the MediaPipe framework for hand gesture identification in real-time video streams. Subsequently, the system utilizes audio signals to provide immediate feedback by converting the detected gestures into corresponding sounds. The feature extraction CNN algorithm is implemented in Python, while the execution takes place on a Raspberry Pi connected to an external camera utilizing OpenCV libraries. Through this comprehensive approach, the system endeavours to bridge the communication gap and enhance the inclusion of deaf and mute individuals in various social settings.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling of Energy Consumption for Building Automation Systems Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In the realm of building automation systems, efficient energy consumption modeling stands as a crucial element for sustainable and intelligent environments. This paper presents a predictive modeling approach utilizing deep learning networks like Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks, alongside comparisons with Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) and Bidirectional LSTM (Bi-LSTM) architectures, for predicting energy utilization within buildings. The study employs a smart home dataset from the UMASS Repository, demonstrating the model's effectiveness in capturing temporal dependencies and delivering accurate predictions. The methodology encompasses comprehensive data preprocessing, model training, and evaluation using key performance metrics. Significantly, the obtained results showcase the superior performance of the LSTM model over GRU and Bi-LSTM, with a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.2662, Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 0.4067, and Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 0.1654. These metrics underscore the model's capability to provide reliable and accurate predictions, thereby contributing to optimizing energy management within building automation systems. The demonstrated success of the predictive model highlights its potential significance in advancing sustainable practices, promoting resource efficiency, and facilitating intelligent decision-making within the realm of intelligent buildings.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Bricks Making from Waste Plastic Bags
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Plastic is being used more and more in our daily lives, which has caused the production of plastic goods to rise globally. Polyethylene is a readily available polymer that is used to make plastic bags. Human activity generates about 350 million tons of plastic waste annually. The majority of plastic bags wind up in landfills, where they take about 300 years to decompose since they are expensive and difficult to recycle. When animals inadvertently consume them, they decompose into minute particles that contaminate the land, waterways, and food chains. Plastic bags originate as fossil fuels and wind up in the seas and landfills as toxic trash. Plastic bags raise the risk of stroke and cardiovascular illness as well as obesity, diabetes, and infertility. According to statistics, plastic garbage alone causes the deaths of about 100 million marine species annually.Our proposed solution focuses on polyethylene covers of lower thickness in microns are collected and treated as raw material. After several basic processes like crushing, heating and cooling processes are done with the help of Programmable Logic Controllers(PLC). It provides an alternative to conventional concrete bricks by using the waste plastic bags and assure environmental friendliness. Thus the bricks are made with different ratios as completely plastic and partial plastic and sand which is cost effective and eco-friendly bricks

articleTitle: Wireless Charging for Electric Vehicle Using Tesla Coil
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: An electrical vehicle (EV) wireless charging system has several advantages over a cable charging system, including simplicity, durability, and safety. The basic idea of a wireless power transfer (WPT) system is the inductive connection of the primary (transmitter) and secondary (receiver) coils. The WPT system and PVG can be connected to offer an environmentally friendly energy source for electric car charging. Actually, power can be wireless transferred from a PV generator across a gap to an EV battery using the principle of magnetic induction. This study proposes and describes the novel WPT system with PV generator as a result. A modeling of a photovoltaic source is presented after a discussion of a PV module's features. Next, to ensure that the PV generator produces the optimal amount of power.

articleTitle: Identification of Coherent Group of Generators Based on Modularity Clustering to Improve System's Resiliency
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Networks for transmitting and distributing electricity are being built and extended over large geographic regions. The main aim of transmission and distribution network planning depends on reliability improvement. Meanwhile attaining power system stability during the events is a major task. This paper proposes a controlled clustering based on the coherency detection of generators by performing the correlation coefficient of the generator's rotor angle. Traditionally, the coherency of generators can be predetermined offline. A new online coherency detection is framed based on the synchronizing torque coefficient. The proposed methodology implements modularity clustering based on the correlation coefficient and synchronizing torque coefficient. In addition to achieving realtime coherency detection, the suggested method offers network integrity metrics for analyzing the power system's dynamic behavior. The effectiveness of our method is illustrated by a simulated case study on the IEEE 39 bus system, which consists of 10 generators after a typical events.

articleTitle: Enhancing Precision in Facial Micro- Expression Recognition with Support Vector Machine in Comparison to ELM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The primary objective of this study is to develop a new method for recognising facial micro-expressions by comparing the accuracy of the SVM and ELM algorithms. The extreme learning machine (N=10) and support vector machine (N=10) used a sample size of 10 and 20 iterations respectively to identify micro expressions with g power of 80%, limit of 0.608, and confidence stretch of 95%. In comparison to extreme learning machines, which have an accuracy of 91.0%, support vector machines will deliver superior exactness (94.8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>). The difference in statistical significance, p = 0.608 (p<0.05), According to the free example T -test value, the study's findings are not statistically significant. When it comes to detecting facial micro-expressions, support vector machine algorithms outperform extreme learning machine methods in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Impact of Wind Energy Conversion System on Fault Clearance Time
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The Critical Clearance Time analysis of an electric power system is crucial in designing the protective devices. The Critical Clearing Time analysis of Wind Energy Conversion System on IEEE 14 bus is done in this work using Power System Analysis Toolbox. Using Time Domain Simulation, the rotor angle stability of the power system is investigated under stable and unstable conditions for determining Critical Clearing Time. A three-phase fault is simulated at various buses to analyze the effect of fault location and critical clearing time on the system stability. The perturbations of the rotor angle are also analyzed during fault and verified whether it satisfies the Fault Ride Through standards.

articleTitle: Exploring Spectral Indices for Improved Water Body Classification in Landsat Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Accurate identification of water bodies in Landsat images is crucial for many applications such as environmental monitoring and water resource management. This paper analytically evaluates various spectral indices such as Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI), Modified Normalized Difference Water Index (MNDWI), Automatic Water Extraction Index (AWEI), New Water Index (NWI), Water Ratio Index (WRI) for water classification to enhance the accuracy of water classification in Landsat satellite images. This work systematically investigates the effectiveness of these spectral indices in different landscapes and environmental conditions. Its main objective is to identify optimal spectral indices that ensure a robust and accurate classification of water bodies. The results of this work will play a crucial role in advancing remote sensing applications that will significantly contribute to the accuracy of environmental research and monitoring initiatives.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Productivity of Solar Water Desalination System Using Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of single basin solar desalination unit equipped with pebbles and granite rock as filling material. Filling materials are thermal energy storage materials which absorbs solar heat and thus enhances the productivity of potable water. Even in low-light conditions, solar stills may provide satisfactory outcomes. The evaporation rate and output of solar still can be improved by using filler materials. Experiments are designed using Taguchi's technique and the distillate output is optimized using firefly algorithm. The still with pebbles provides the maximum daily productivity as compared with granite rock filling due to the absorption of higher solar energy. A deviation of 6.58% is observed between pebble and granite rock as thermal energy storage material.

articleTitle: Satellite Image Denoising Using Optimized Pulse Coupling Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Satellite image denoising is of utmost importance in various applications weather monitoring, flood control and crop monitoring focusing on enhancing the visual quality of affected images. Denoising is a contemporary trend in the application of image processing, yet encounters numerous restrictions attributed to environmental conditions. In recent times, there has been extensive exploration of DL (deep learning) methods for the purpose of noise removal in satellite images. This work presents a DL based optimization model for Satellite image denoising. That is the DL model PCN (pulse coupling network) with AF (artificial flora) optimizer is used for parameter enhancement in PCN. PSNR and SSIM values achieved are 44.8 and 0.89 respectivelyon the FloodNet database. Thus, the analysis yielded superior performance and achieved better quality images.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based Digital Identity for Secure Authentication of IoT Devices In 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The growing use of IoT in 5G networks has led to new security concerns, particularly related to the lack of authentication mechanisms. This paper proposes a new way to solve this problem by using blockchain-based digital tokens to identify IoT devices and enable secure communication over 5G networks, etc. Our Digital Identity Authentication using Blockchain (DIA-Be) approach proposed in this paper is to create a unique blockchain- based digital identity for each device. The created digital identities are verified using cryptographic protocols and stored in a tamper- proof decentralized ledger. These digital identities can be used to authenticate devices as they connect to a network, preventing unauthorized access, and allowing secure communication channels to be established. We discuss the benefits of this approach, including improved security, reliability, and deployment, and highlight some of the challenges that must be addressed when implementing this approach. Our plan shows our commitment to improving the security of IoT devices in 5G networks, with the ability to create safe and secure IoT devices that can share communications with each other without a network.

articleTitle: Raspberry Pi based Color and Shape Detection Bot
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative sorting system that leverages, advanced image processing capabilities, particularly focusing on color and shape detection, integrated into a robotic platform. The cost-effective solution, utilizes the Raspberry Pi single-board computer to maximize computational power, achieving efficient object sorting. The system excels in identifying, sorting, and processing objects, based on color and shape attributes, with added functionality for obstacle detection. Through seamless integration of Raspberry Pi with Python programming, and advanced image processing, the project showcases the potential of this approach, in addressing challenges in automation and robotics. This technology holds promise for future applications, in medical imaging and pharmaceutical settings, offering efficient analysis and sorting based on color and shape characteristics.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Classification using sEMG Signals and Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Electromyographic signals offer details on a muscle activity of a person. In the case of hand movements various combinations of forearm muscles must be activated in order to carry out each gesture, which results in unique electrical patterns. On the other hand, identifying the motion being executed is made possible by the examination of these patterns of muscle activation, which are captured by EMG signals. This article presents a novel implementation on hand gesture classification utilizing Electromyography (EMG) signals recorded through a MYO Thalmic bracelet. The dataset consists of raw data collected from 36 subjects, each executing a series of static hand gestures. The classification model employed for this study is an ensemble of decision trees, achieving an impressive validation accuracy of 98.0% and a test accuracy of 98.1 %. The article outlines the dataset details, recording methodology, and provides an in-depth analysis of the model architecture, hyperparameters, and training results.

articleTitle: Intelligent Controller Based Custom Power Device for Power Quality Improvement
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Modern energy demands are increasing, and sustainability is becoming more and more important. As a result, making effective use of power resources is crucial. For contemporary grid systems, power quality and the incorporation of renewable energy sources have emerged as critical concerns. The objective of this project is to improve power quality in a three-phase grid system while enhancing the integration of renewable energy sources. In order to solve power quality concerns and guarantee effective use of renewable energy, the project integrates a number of essential elements. The grid system is the main source of electrical power, but it is vulnerable to issues with power quality, such as voltage swells and sags.

Author Keywords: Adaptive Neuro - Fuzzy Inference System: ANFIS

articleTitle: Developing a Secure and Multilingual Chat App with Real-Time Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In the era of digital communication there are huge number of chatting applications to communicate with peoples globally. Generally, people make chat group and form community for their work and efficiency. The peoples of different geographical and linguistic background get interconnected. For talking within the group user at least required a skill of Hindi or English language. The paper delves into the development of chat application Linguolock using ML-Kit and Firebase with the objectives of security, multilingual communication, real time translation and OTP base sign-in. The app is specifically built for Android OS due to higher number of people in India use smartphone powered by Android. This app majorly supports six languages translation Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Punjabi, Tamil and Telugu. As per ensuring the privacy and security concerns of users chat message AES-GCM technique implemented within the app for encrypting the message. Using this system the user communicates effectively in different languages and the conversation messages are stored securely.

articleTitle: A Vision-Based Traffic Accident Analysis and Tracking system from Traffic Surveillance Video
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Traffic accidents pose significant challenges to road safety and transportation management worldwide. Timely and accurate analysis of these incidents is crucial for effective response and mitigation. This paper presents a novel VisionBased Traffic Accident Analysis and Tracking System designed to detect, analyze, and track traffic accidents from surveillance videos using advanced image processing techniques. Recent research methodology has unlimited in realizing the object trajectories of vehicle accident connected information detecting and take out the features relationships. The proposed research paper recommends a road traffic accident tracking systems that assist to establish whether every video sequence demonstrates mishap by producing and considering vehicle object trajectories using Vehicle Influence Location Generator and CNN classifier. In the proposed system, the vehicle influence location generator includes three parameters: vehicle object trajectories the distances between vehicles and accident analysis. First parameter, vehicle portions are identified by rectangle bounding box in green colour. The second parameter, vehicle portion centre positions are represented by dots using Region of Interest (ROI). The final parameters, the distances between previous vehicle frame and current vehicle frame are represented by points. The proposed system considered threshold value for distance calculation and update the values. Finally, the opportunity of a disaster is characterized by red circles. A CNN will be used to analyze the accident from the Vehicle Influence Location Generator produced by vehicle object trajectories. The proposed model was trained using CADP dataset in the training and testing stage, and it was able to obtain an estimated 96.5 % accuracy rate in overall proposed traffic accident detection.

Author Keywords: Haar cascade classifier and Image Processing

articleTitle: Secure and Energy-Efficient Smart Home Automation: A User-Based Fingerprint Security System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: As smart home technology becomes more and more common, there is an increasing demand for user identification techniques that are both secure and energy-efficient. This study highlights the energy economy while introducing a novel automatic fingerprint security system for smart home applications. To increase security, the suggested solution uses a fingerprint scanner. Users may control various appliances and gadgets via a website or mobile app. By activating smart appliances based on user identification, the system actively helps energy saving and offers sophisticated security features, such as room-specific access and emphasizing user-centricity. The project includes both software and hardware elements, including a MongoDB database, Raspberry Pi microcontroller, fingerprint reader, and web based React JS control interface. Thorough testing and assessment confirm the system's ability to detect reliably.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Slime Mould Meta Heuristic Algorithm and Machine Learning Technique for Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Network anomaly prediction is a crucial aspect of network security, as it helps identify unusual or potentially malicious activities within a computer network. There are several approaches and techniques used for network anomaly prediction, and Machine Learning (ML) is often employed due to its ability to detect patterns and anomalies in large datasets. In this research, network anomaly detection is carried out by three stages. In first stage, data set from IEEE data port is collected and LRC, RFC models are trained for prediction. In second stage, dimension reduction algorithm PCA is used for preprocessing and ML models are trained for prediction. In third stage, the hybrid PCA +SMA is proposed along with ML models for prediction. From this analysis, the hybrid PCA+SMA+ML provide better performance (accuracy 96) compared with previous three stages. Finally, the hybrid PCA+SMA+RFC is selected for final deployment.

articleTitle: Designing of Variables Modified Double Sampling Plan with Double Specification Limits
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In this manuscript, designing of a modified version of variables double sampling plan for the application of measureable quality characteristics is proposed and this plan is designated as variables modified double sampling plan. The suggested sampling plan can be used for inspecting the quality characteristics which are measured on numerical scale with double specification limits. The suitable parameters for suggested variables modified double sampling plan for known sigma are obtained which satisfy both producer's and consumer's risk at their specified quality levels. By formulating a nonlinear programming problem to minimize the average sample number, the optimal plan parameters are determined. The ultimate focus of this manuscript is to reduce the average sample number with defend to both producer and the consumer, contemplate with other existing variables sampling plans with double specification limits. Merits of the suggested variables modified double sampling plan under double specification limits are discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis of DC Characteristics for Tin Oxide (SnO2) based Thin Film Transistor infused with Nickel Material
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This paper presents an investigation into the impact of Nickel on the DC characteristics of a proposed Thin Film Transistor (TFT) reliant on Tin Oxide (SnO2). A thorough analysis is conducted on the changes in the device's drain current after the introduction of Nickel. By examining the VI characteristics of the device, the deviation in drain current due to the presence of Nickel is assessed. The results indicate improved current dissipation compared to previously available MOSFETs. On altering/tweaking the thickness of the Tin Oxide (SnO2), intending to be the dielectric medium, variations in the current being transited was analyzed. The highest drain current recorded was 5nm, and the suggested device was enhanced by extending thechannellength to 7 μm, The presence of Nickel has greatly impacted the drain current, thus elevating the same to a levelof above 3.2nm than the existing silicon based MOSFETs'. An improvement current drive of 74% from the existing work has been obtained using this nickel material for the SnO2 based TFT. The responsive VI characteristics of the device shows its inclusivity for detecting the toxicity present in food substances.

articleTitle: Automated Tomato Leaf Disease Identification via Transfer Learning Approach on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Tomatoes are the most nutrient-dense, most cultivated, and most consumed vegetables in the world, and they are attractive due to their therapeutic properties. On the other hand, tomato crops are susceptible to numerous diseases that can lower or completely destroy tomato production; hence, the fast and precise diagnosis of tomato infections plays a vital role in crop protection. As a result, researchers have created numerous deep learning models for the automated classification of tomato leaf diseases. Transfer learning has made it possible to apply solutions from one area to another, enabling the development of stronger and more effective solutions for the diagnosis of tomato leaf diseases. This article utilized transfer learning on different forms of standard CNN architecture, like DarkNet-19, ShuffleNet, and ResNet-18, to diagnose tomato plant diseases from its leaf images. Also, this article assesses the model's performance with stochastic gradient descent (SGD), RMSProp, and adaptive moment estimation (Adam). The outcome of the experiment shows how successful the model is classifying tomato leaf diseases automatically with the transfer learning technique.

articleTitle: Simulation and Performance Analysis of Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions and pollution in our environment can be achieved with electric automobiles. Electric Vehicle is highly required to replace the impact of IC engines. The goals include enhancing fuel efficiency, cutting emissions, guaranteeing drivability, and preserving the energy storage system's longevity and current state of charge while taking constraints into account. Power train that is driven by fuel cells, batteries, and super capacitors can offer an economical transportation solution. An effective Energy Management System (EMS) is highly required to distribute power across the power train's components by choosing the right operating modes. This article has discussed the electric vehicle's modeling. An optimized model has been created by taking into account real key parameters. This study compares the actual speed of the vehicle with the input drive speed to determine the optimal performance of an electric car. The initial and final charge of the battery is used to compare the energy consumption value of the electric vehicle. Examined has been the impact of many characteristics on the energy consumption and performance of vehicles.

articleTitle: IOT Based Virtual Telepresence Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This paper, marks an innovative exploration of robotics, IoT, and telepresence technologies, aiming to create a versatile and user-friendly robot, for remote control and real-time presence in distant locations. The key components and functionalities of this work, include the ESP32 micro controller, which serves as the central brain, interfacing with an analog joystick for user control. The Raspberry Pi camera, integrated through Message Queuing Telemetry Protocol, enhances capabilities, with high-quality real-time video, streaming to provide an immersive experience. The L298N motor driver facilitates precise control over the robot's mobility, allowing it to navigate in any direction. ESP32's role in interfacing with the analog joystick, for movement control is emphasized. As a conclusion, the integration of hardware and software components, in the development of the IoT based Virtual telepresence robot, represents a significant leap forward in the realm of remote robotics.

articleTitle: Plant Diseases Detection Using Deep Learning and Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This research delves into deep learning and machine vision applications for plant leaf disease detection in agricultural settings, focusing on farm village datasets. Utilizing a blend of authentic farm village data and synthetic data from Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), three advanced convolutional neural network (CNN) models VGG16, ResNet50, and InceptionNet V3 are employed with transfer learning. Leveraging transfer learning enhances model performance through fine-tuning pre-trained networks. The study systematically evaluates models based on key metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. Results showcase the methodology's robustness, with ResNet50 emerging as the leading performer at 83.23%, contributing to precision agriculture's advancements with promising implications for sustainable farming and crop yield optimization.

articleTitle: Neural Network Based Voltage Source Converter for Power Management of Hybrid Energy System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Controlling and co-ordination of energy management in different power generation or resources is always complex task in hybrid microgrid. To integrate renewable energy sources like solar-wind and battery multiple power converters usage required. The overall performance of the hybrid microgrid power system network is dependent on the operating of the power converters. Voltage Source Converters (VSCs) can optimize power flow within a microgrid or power system by providing advanced control capabilities. VSCs offer a range of control capabilities that can be leveraged to optimize power flow within microgrids and power systems. Their ability to regulate voltage, control reactive power, and respond dynamically to changes in the system makes them valuable components for improving efficiency and reliability in various operational scenarios. In this paper an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) controller is developed to operate the single phase VSC converter at load side. To reach the load demand and enhance the power quality battery supported is considered to the solar and wind power generation. The performance of the proposed ANN based hybrid microgrid is investigated on two scenarios such as steady load connected to the variable solarwind power generation and performance of the system when dynamic load is connected at constant PV and wind power generations. Form the obtained simulation results on these both these cases; the proposed ANN control strategy better energy management between solar-wind and battery energy sources.

articleTitle: Optimization of Three-Ring Concentric Circular Antenna Arrays for Maximum Side Lobe Level Reduction
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This study focuses on the perfect creation of concentric circular antenna arrays (CCAAs) regardless of the presence of a central feeding element. The main goal is to find the current excitation weights and ring radius that minimize side lobe level (SLL) as much as possible. These concentric circular antenna arrays can be utilized in various applications, including mobile cognitive radio ad hoc networks and smart grids. The Taguchi method was employed as the optimization strategy. Detailed numerical results indicate that the CCAA, when fed by a yield element, significantly lowers the SLL compared to a similar array without a central feeding element. Moreover, a specific CCAA configuration, consisting of 4, 6, and 8 components in three succeeding loops and a central feeding component, achieves the lowest SLL of -35.70 dB.

articleTitle: Enhanced Diabetic Retinopathyanalysis: Unet-Based Lesion Segmentation Coupled with Mobilenetv2 for Feature Extraction and Efficientnetb0 for Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In this research, we address the critical issue of precise Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) diagnosis, a condition of ten leading severe vision impairment or blindness in diabetic patients. Leveraging advanced deep learning models and innovative image processing techniques, our study focuses on accurate retinal image segmentation using a UNet model. This segmentation method delineates lesions and retinal structures effectively. Subsequently, Gabor filters are applied for intricate texture pattern extraction, indicative of diverse retinopathy stages. Integrating MobileNetV2 for feature extraction and EfficientNetB0 for multi-class classification significantly enhances the diagnostic accuracy. Our developed system exhibits a promising 91.2% test accuracy, showcasing its potential in DR diagnosis. While challenges related to varying severity levels persist, our robust framework lays the groundwork for future refinements. By amalgamating sophisticated image segmentation, feature extraction, and classification techniques, our system provides a solid foundation for accurate and timely DR assessment. With continuous enhancements, including the incorporation of more extensive and diverse datasets, our approach holds the promise to revolutionize DR diagnostics. The integration of cutting-edge technology into medical practices underscores the transformative impact of artificial intelligence in the realm of ophthalmology, promising improved patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Harnessing Deep Learning Techniques for Dysarthria Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Dysarthria, a motor speech disorder resulting from neurological impairments. This study explores various approaches for the automated detection of dysarthria, integrating both traditional and emerging technologies. Speech assessments by acoustic analysis, machine learning models, and deep learning techniques are considered. Machine learning models are trained on datasets containing normal and dysarthric speech for males and females, while deep learning methods, including convolutional and recurrent neural networks, are employed to automatically learn features from speech data. Our goal is to develop a reliable and accessible dysarthria detection system thatcomplements the expertise of healthcare professionals. Validation using diverse datasets is emphasized, acknowledging the importance of early detection and intervention in improving outcomes for individuals with dysarthria.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Critical Parameter of Liquid Insulation Used in Power Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Transformers frequently employ mineral oil as an insulator. Subdued mineral oil replacements are made with vegetable oils. Antioxidants are substances that enhance the vegetable oil performance in power transformers. Vegetable oil has two main benefits: it is environmentally friendly and biodegradable. The organic fatty acids that are employed in this study are selected and combined in different proportions, and they include oil from olives, the bran of rice fluid, oil from coconuts, and oil from sunflowers. The critical elements of IEC standards are Viscosity, Flash over this regard, Fire point, and Breakdown voltage.

articleTitle: Investigation of Small Signal Stability Enhancement through Combined Local and Wide Area PSS in PV Integration in Multimachine Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: The small signal stability ensures in power system synchronous operation during small disturbances, involving analysis of local and inter-area oscillatory modes. To address insufficient damping torque, this work proposes development of power system stabilizers (PSS) optimally tuned using real-coded genetic algorithm. The input signal for the local PSS is rotor speed deviation and the remote input for the wide area PSS is tie line power which will be obtained from the Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) in WAMS. The Genetic Algorithm-tuned local PSS is applied to dampen local and inter-area oscillations in a Multimachine 11 Bus two-area power system using MATLAB/SIMULINK 2022b version and Modal analysis in Digsilent PowerFactory 2022, considering machine state variables and their impact on controllability. The study also explores the influence of PV penetration on small signal stability and determines allowable PV penetration during faults for small signal stability improvement in a two-area power system.

articleTitle: Analysing Transaction Data in Supermarkets-Role of Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This research study is based on the analysis of transaction data in supermarkets. Various mechanisms and technologies of data mining, data warehousing, and other consumer relationship management (CRM) strategies have been influenced to collect and analyses this information. The main purpose of this research is to investigate the custom benefits to determined consumer features in a retail supermarket, by executing data mining strategies on deals transaction data with the aid of data mining implements. Thematic analysis, based on the objectives are highlighted in this section. Adequate leadership of sales transaction data is as essential as any other support for a retail supermarket mart. Primary data analysis process is highlighted in this methodology section. The survey has been conducted among 65 people due to understanding the role of data mining in transaction data in supermarkets. Researchers are capable to collect data with the support of the primary data collection process. Therefore, SPSS (Statistical Package for the Social Sciences) helps to analyses data statistically. Overall discussion of the research topic is highlighted in this section. Additionally, some data mining approaches have been containing decision trees (DT), genetic algorithms (GA), artificial neural networks (ANN), association rules (AR), and so on are generally utilised to solve issues related to customers in different areas like science, engineering, finance and business. Analysis the statistical information with the support of the collected data is being generated. Therefore, important factors that play an important role in supermarket is being highlighted.

articleTitle: Microstrip Patch Slot Antenna with Enhanced Bandwidth and Multiple Parasitic Patches
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: This research presents a Micro strip patch antenna design that includes two parasitic patches and a strategically positioned slot, resulting in a significant increase in its bandwidth. Initially, an antenna is constructed using Microstrip feed with specific dimensions (x: 2 mm, y: 5 mm, z: 0 mm). Parametric analysis of the patches is carried out to validate the anticipated improvement in bandwidth. Subsequently, an antenna with two parasitic patches is manufactured and tested, resulting in a measured bandwidth (|s_11|<-10 dB) ranging from 8.23 to 15.14 GHz, covering 54.2% of the bandwidth. Furthermore, slots are incorporated into the parasitic patches of the antenna, significantly enhancing its bandwidth capabilities. Through comprehensive testing and experimentation, the upgraded antenna with the additional slots attains an impressive 10-dB impedance bandwidth of 63.25%, extending from 8.21 to 15.11 GHz. This underscores the considerable potential for improving bandwidth through intelligent design modifications, opening avenues for enhanced antenna performance in diverse applications.

articleTitle: Energy-Aware Adaptive Dijkstra: A Robust Routing Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks in Dynamic Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In the realm of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN s), the quest for efficient routing algorithms that optimize energy consumption and adapt to dynamic network conditions is paramount. This paper introduces a novel routing algorithm, Energy-Aware Adaptive Dijkstra (EAAD), designed to address these challenges. EAAD leverages the principles of Dijkstra's algorithm while incorporating energy-awareness and adaptability to mobility. The algorithm computes energy-efficient paths from source nodes to sinks, taking into account the node's energy levels and the distance involved. Moreover, EAAD accommodates mobility-induced changes by dynamically recalculating routes. In a simulation-based evaluation, EAAD demonstrated superior performance in terms of energy conservation and adaptability, resulting in a higher number of alive nodes and enhanced throughput. EAAD offers a promising solution for optimizing routing in WSN s, contributing to prolonged network lifetime and robustness in dynamic environments. Its potential extends to diverse applications where energy-efficient routing is vital.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Faults Using Intelligent Approach in Microgrid Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Microgrids serve as vital for incorporating renewable energy sources into the electricity grid. Classifying faults is difficult because of the reverse power flow, blinding of protection, and sympathetic tripping. Conventional overcurrent protection relays have challenges in microgrids due to the restricted fault current generated by grid-connected renewable energy inverters. The paper proposes an approach for classifying faults in a microgrid to address these problems. To classify the fault types based on the Multilayer Feedforward Neural Network (MLFNN). The implementation of MLFNN uses four feature selections like dphi/dt (differential ROCPAD), dv/dt (differential ROCOV(pu/s)), dp/dt (differential active power change with time (pu/s)) and dq/dt (differential reactive power change with time(pu/s). Using these four features in the proposed MLFNN gives better accuracy. The proposed method is assessed using a 6-bus Radial AC microgrid system. Different test cases were undertaken to locate the fault classification by varying fault resistances in the range of 1 to 100 ohms. Moreover, this proposed work has shown favourable results using other models, such as support vector machines, for fault categorization.

articleTitle: Effective Garbage Monitoring System Using GSM Module
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Inefficient garbage collection not only leads to overflowing bins and unpleasant but also poses significant environmental and health risks. This paper proposes an effective garbage monitoring system utilizing a GSM module for real-time fill-level detection and automated alerts. The system employs ultrasonic sensors to measure garbage level within the bin, triggering an alert (SMS or data transmission) to designated authorities via the GSM module when a predefined threshold is reached. This enables optimized collection schedules, reducing unnecessary trips, fuel consumption, and associated emissions. Additionally, the system can be integrated with GPS for location tracking, facilitating targeted waste management in geographically dispersed areas. The proposed system offers a cost-effective and scalable solution for enhancing waste management efficiency, promoting environmental sustainability, and improving public health.

articleTitle: Novel Approach for Detecting Brain Neoplasm Using Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: One of the most grinding and significant provoca- tions in the domain of handling images related to medicine is the segmentation of brain neoplasms due to physical categorization with the assist of humans might provoke inappropriate prognosis also an evaluation. Also whenever you've got an abundance of information required being processed, it is a challenging job. sorted through. The extraction of neoplasm regions from pictures becomes difficult since brain neoplasms have a wide variety of appearances and resemble normal tissues. proposed a technique for extracting brain neoplasms from 2D MRIs of the brain using the CNN clustering algorithm, which was then used to train conventional classifiers and a convolutional neural network. For the purpose of this work, a live collection with diverse Neoplasm dimensions, places shapes, and intensity levels of images was used. Sci-kit-Learn was used to implement Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Random Forest, two traditional classifiers, in the traditional classifier section. Then, due to it performing better than the conventional ones, went we now turn to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), that are constructed by using Tensorflow along with Keras. The accuracy rate achieved by CNN was 88.0%, which is impressive.

articleTitle: ANN-based Control of Dual-Stage Converter for Standalone Solar PV Battery System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Energy resources expansion and depletion are in the equivalent point of growth vital in global. In recent years, researchers' eye on the energy sources has progressed with the aid of renewable sources like solar, wind and water turbines. In this proposed system has eagerly focused the energy production using ministerial effect from the solar energy. This system has designed novel photovoltaic cells and it generates huge and constant amount of power with the help of solar energy. Solar photovoltaic cells has keen and comfort cost effective power generation house. These standalone solar PV batteries have a proper alternative source for the grid unavailable power supplies. This standalone PV cells are mutually integrated with the DC-DC converter, DC-AC converter and Load cells. Virtually Synchronized Generator (VSG) is used to control and maximize the power utilization of the corresponding solar as well as AC power units. ANN based Fuzzy algorithm is used to optimize the entire purposes in an efficient manner. This algorithm based dual stage standalone PV battery is used to enhance the energy observing as well output power compensation.

articleTitle: Improving Irrigation Effectiveness: Developing and Applying an Evapotranspiration Detector for Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In the farming lands of agriculture, water is lost due to evaporation and transpiration. The evaporation and transpiration rate varies day by day according to the climatic conditions of the area. Both overwatering and underwatering are the primary factors influencing a plant's ability to grow. To find the accurate irrigation level we need to identify the loss of water due to evaporation and transpiration. To identify this loss we planned to design the evapotranspiration detector. This detector is used to find the moisture content in soil and plants. Through this, monitoring the amount of water to be irrigated can be determined. This could help in protecting the agricultural land from water logging and irrigation management. This paper describes the working and construction of an evapotranspiration detector.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Dielectric Characteristics of Blended Natural Ester Oil with Transformer Oil with Optimal Ratio using Grey Relational Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: In the present High voltage application system, natural ester oils are being considered as a viable solution to the replacement of Petroleum-based mineral oil due to their promising environmental conditions, like being renewable, biodegradable, not hazards to water, having a low fire point, and having a high flash point. Blended techniques play a crucial role in this research. This paper investigates that vegetable oils such as Groundnut Oil (GO) and Rice Bran Oil (RBO) have low viscosity, low fatty content, and high breakdown strength in nature, so it suggests better alternatives for mineral oils. Blended GO and RBO oils with various concentrations give the desired performance compared to blended mineral oil. Although this research describes the comparison between various concentrations of vegetable oils and experimental measurements of dielectric properties, From the experimental results, it can be concluded that the mixed ratio samples of 60:40 and 70:30 of groundnut and rice bran vegetable oils enhanced critical properties, which proves the better alternative solution to the transformer mineral oil. Further, the optimized results for the system's insulation can be analyzed using the Grey relational analysis (GRA) method.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach on Parkinson Detection with Deep Ensemble Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Parkinson Disease (PD) is one of the serious and life- threatening disease treated by doctors with various progressive diagnosis. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) plays a significant role in treating the disease in the early stages. Although various screening techniques are utilized for PD, MRI technique provides accurate extraction of Parkinson features impacting the disease. The emerging growth of artificial intelligence frameworks in recent days create a strong foundation in medical image processing and critical disease inference. The presented system formulated with such framework using an ensemble approach. The MARI images are collected from UCI repository. The involvement of image processing technology and deep learning, deep ensemble network (DEN) is developed here. The primary goal of the system is to detect the presence of Parkinson disease in the early stages. The proposed approach is created with deep ensemble process with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Long-Short Term Memory model (LSTM) with ADAM optimizer. The performance of the system is evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall and F1score. Through DEN model, accuracy of 98% is achieved. The quantitative parameters are compared with the existing state of art approaches.

articleTitle: Image-Based Early Classification of Tomato Leaf Diseases Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Food for the world's population is largely produced by plants, however, plant diseases cause substantial output losses. Continuous monitoring can reduce these losses. However, manual disease monitoring of plants is labor-intensive and error-prone. Early disease diagnosis utilizing computer vision and artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a viable answer to this problem. This strategy lessens the detrimental effects of illnesses and gets around the drawbacks of ongoing human monitoring. After comparing the Convolutional neural network (CNN) with architectures such as ResNet, MobileNet, DenseNet, and InceptionV3, Cnn was applied to simple images of tomato leaves and classified into several tomato leaf diseases. We assessed the models' performance in a variety of ways, including binary classification (distinguishing between healthy and unhealthy leaves), and seven-class classification (categorizing healthy leaves and various groups of diseased leaves). After opting for Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), we were able to achieve a classification accuracy of 95.8%.

articleTitle: Text Generation using Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Character-based generation models benefit from the application of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) cells. In handling sequential data, Single-Dimensional Convolutional LSTM networks also exhibit usefulness. The impact of the quantity of LSTM cells on the generated content quality is substantial, affecting the model's tendency towards overfitting or underfitting. Our investigation into the influence of LSTM cell quantity reveals an initial enhancement in predictive performance with increased cell numbers. However, surpassing a specific threshold of LSTM cells leads to a decline in model effectiveness. Optimizing the corpus vocabulary size contributes to superior outcomes when reduced.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Performance of Serial and Parallel Web Crawlers
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Intelligent Techniques in Control, Optimization and Signal Processing (INCOS)
abstract: Web crawlers, also known as web spiders or web robots, are automated programs that systematically browse the World Wide Web, indexing web pages and gathering data for various purposes. This paper addresses the inefficiency of default Python crawlers, caused by the Global Interpreter Lock (GIL), in the context of web page collection for search engines. It aims to create a concurrent Python crawler and compare its performance with a single-threaded counterpart. The crawler will undergo three iterations: a sequential version, a concurrent version using thread pool executor, and an aiohttp version for concurrent requests. Performance metrics such as speed of retrieval, internal processing, and memory requirements will be analyzed. The goal is to develop an efficient Python crawler for continuous web crawling, providing insights for developers and users, and comparing Python's performance with another programming language.

articleTitle: Battery Health Monitoring System in Electric Vehicles for Battery Swapping
